annotations.title: List the brand's imported Mercatus products

description:
[read-only] The brand's imported Mercatus Liber products (GID, title, handle, status, price range, image, variant count, import time), newest first, `limit` 1-100 per page with `cursor` paging, plus the import's state (`import.running`, last run). `brandId` is required on an account-wide connection. Needs the explicit `stores:manage` scope plus `write`.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/stores/mercatus/import.)

brandId.description: The brand (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.

name: mercatus_store_products
